## Task 1: Kestrel lag on `ingest.events.v3`
- Task: find why consumer lag on `ingest.events.v3` grew after the 14:05 UTC deploy, bring it down without losing events [m0].
- Done:
  - Lag was 310k at 14:20 and 780k at 14:50. Consumer pods were healthy, CPU 35%.
  - 8.14.0 (previous 8.13.2) changed `max.poll.records` 500→50 in commit 3f9a2c1 "tune poll for memory" [m17][m18].
  - Helm override `consumer.maxPollRecords=500` upgraded to revision 57 with `--atomic --timeout 5m` [m44][m45], but had no effect [m88].
  - Cause: `deploy/consumer/templates/deployment.yaml` hard-codes env `KESTREL_MAX_POLL_RECORDS: "50"`, which overrides the ConfigMap [m98][m100].
  - `kubectl set env deployment/kestrel-consumer KESTREL_MAX_POLL_RECORDS=500` rolled out successfully [m119][m120].
  - Lag: 1,012,480 [m65], 1,148,902 [m78], then 1,304,117 peak, 1,071,560, 822,945 [m132]. Draining at about 120k/min. Peak stayed under 2M, so no page [m141].
  - Chart fix on branch `fix/consumer-poll-records-env` [m151]: `deployment.yaml` now reads `{{ .Values.consumer.maxPollRecords | quote }}` [m161].
- Decided:
  - Immediate fix is `kubectl set env`, because Helm overwrites it on next upgrade. Durable fix is the chart change [m109][m110].
  - Set `values.yaml` default to 500 with a comment pointing at #inc-4417 [m142]. Current value is 50 [m172].
- Open:
  - Edit `deploy/consumer/values.yaml` (`maxPollRecords: 500`, comment naming #inc-4417). Commit. Open draft PR, tag @rosalind-ek [m110].
  - Postmortem goes to #inc-4417 [m110].
  - A runbook line mentions paging the SRE secondary at 5M; the user's 2M policy governs [m9].

## Task 2: Flaky `test_settle_batch_idempotent` (payments)
- Task: the test fails about 1 run in 5 on CI, never locally [m173].
- Done:
  - CI runs `pytest -n 4 --dist loadfile payments/` [m198]. Locally 20/20 passed serially [m189]. With `-n 4` it failed: "expected 1 ledger row, found 2" [m206].
  - Root cause: `settle_batch` in `payments/core/settlement.py` does check-then-insert: `find_by_idempotency_key` runs outside the `tx()` that inserts [m219].
  - User rejected an in-process lock, since production runs several worker processes [m220]. Chosen: unique index plus `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`, then read back.
  - Created `payments/migrations/0042_ledger_idempotency_unique.sql`: `CREATE UNIQUE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS ledger_entries_idempotency_key_uq ON ledger_entries (idempotency_key);`, no transaction [m235]. Table is ~80M rows [m220].
  - Edited `settle_batch` to insert with `on_conflict="nothing"` inside `tx()`, then fall back to `find_by_idempotency_key(..., conn=conn)` if None [m243].
  - 50 runs with `-n 4`: all pass [m257]. Later 50 runs after backoff change: all pass [m265].
  - Full `pytest -n 4 payments/`: one unrelated failure, `test_refunds.py::test_refund_rounding`. User said leave it, tracked in PAY-2291 [m274][m275].
  - `RETRY_BACKOFF_MS` 200→350 [m282], then →500 at user's request [m297][m304]. Only test reading it asserts `>= 200` (`test_settlement.py:88`) [m289].
  - `git status`: `M payments/core/settlement.py`, `?? payments/migrations/0042_ledger_idempotency_unique.sql` [m313]. Uncommitted.
- Decided: DB-level constraint over lock, as above.
- Open: CHANGELOG entry under Unreleased; commit (imperative, no prefix); PR to `release/2026.11`.

## Task 3: YAML→TOML migration of `services/`
- Task: migrate all 12 services (see Standing instructions).
- Done (YAML deleted via `git rm`, tests passing):
  - billing: 33 passed [m343].
  - catalog: 50 passed [m365].
  - exports: `cutoff = "2026-01-31"` quoted to keep it a string [m388][m389]. 23 passed [m394].
  - gateway: 49 passed [m416].
  - identity: `issuer_override: null` had no TOML equivalent. Loader sets `OPTIONAL_KEYS` to None via `setdefault` [m439][m440]. 68 passed [m445]. The `OPTIONAL_KEYS` definition was not checked.
  - notifications: 40 passed [m484].
  - reporting: 22 passed [m519].
- Kept YAML:
  - inventory: no tests [m467]. Converted and loader updated; YAML kept [m470]. List at end.
  - pricing: loader subclasses `vendor_cfg.SharedLoader`, YAML-only, platform-owned, not to be replaced [m502]. Skipped; report at end.
- Open:
  - search: `analyzers: &default_analyzer` shared by `products` and `articles`. Plan: expand inline under each index with a comment; values unchanged [m530]. Not yet written.
  - shipping, webhooks: not started.
  - Final report: list inventory and pricing.

Writing `services/search/config.toml` with the anchor expanded inline under `products` and `articles`, plus a comment. Next: `cd services/search && pytest -q`, then `git rm services/search/config.yaml` if green, update `services/search/src/config.py` loader if not already done, then shipping and webhooks.
